title: WOBBLEHOARD
short_description: WOBBLEHOARD — a squishy toy that squishes back. Poke it, squish it, pull it and let go: a translucent jelly blob with a glowing core, simulated in real-time 3D soft-body physics, with every sound synthesised as you play. Collecting, merging and trading squishies are coming next.
description:
A squishy toy that squishes back.

Your squishy is a squat dollop of translucent apricot jelly with a soft swirl on top, an ember-coral core glowing inside it and two glossy eyes. It sits on a dark felt mat under a warm amber light, and it is made of physics, not animation: about 640 points held together by a real-time soft-body simulation, so every dent, bulge and wobble is worked out as it happens.

Tap it to poke it. Hold to squish: it flattens, bulges out at the sides and blushes warmer where you press. Press on it and drag outward to pull it into a stretchy lobe, then let go and watch it snap back, overshoot and jiggle to rest. Shove it and the swirl on top flops over and springs back up. Its eyes follow you, go wide when you squeeze and squint happily when you let go, and a fast release shakes loose little air bubbles that rise and pop.

Every sound is synthesised in your browser while you play: the wet thup of a poke, a squelch that follows how hard you are squishing, the bloop of the release and the plop when it lands. There are no recorded sounds and no samples.

Settings: volume, Louder squish, haptics (on devices that can vibrate), screen shake (off by default when your system asks for reduced motion), Gravity or Float (it hovers and drifts instead of sitting on the mat) and graphics quality.

On a phone or tablet: tap to poke, press and hold to squish, press on the squishy and drag outward to pull, drag empty space to turn the view, pinch to zoom, and put two fingers on the squishy to pinch it.

Coming next: more squishies to find, merge and trade. They are designed but not in this build yet. Today it is one squishy to play with.
controls_keyboard: Mouse: click = poke · hold = squish · press on the squishy and drag outward = pull · drag empty space (or right-drag) = turn the view · wheel = zoom. Keys: SPACE tap = poke · SPACE hold = squish · ARROW KEYS turn the view · + / - zoom · G gravity / float · M mute · ESC close the settings panel
controls_touch: Tap = poke · press and hold = squish · press on the squishy and drag outward = pull · drag empty space = turn the view · pinch = zoom · two fingers on the squishy = pinch it
art_direction: One squishy toy photographed on a dark felt play-mat at dusk: an ink-indigo set (#14102a background, plum #2a1744, dusk violet #5b3a86, felt mat #2a2150) under a warm sodium-amber softbox key light (#ffb347) with a cold lagoon-cyan rim light (#59d6e6). The squishy is a squat dollop of translucent apricot-amber jelly with a soft swirl peak on top: glossy specular highlights from the softbox, light passing through its body, and an ember-coral core (#ff5a4d) glowing from inside, casting a warm coloured pool of light on the felt beneath it. Its only face is two glossy ink-dark eyes: no mouth, no limbs, no other character. Cream (#fff1d6), heavy, rounded WOBBLEHOARD wordmark in plain system-style lettering. Moody, tactile and original, deliberately unlike pastel-kawaii toy shelves; no logos, brands or characters from any other game or toy line.
